notes.title: Space adventure is coming — new Catfall trailer
notes.notes: [p]Catfall has gained momentum, and the Ukrainian Games Festival is the perfect occasion to share a fresh look at our sci-fi cat adventure![/p][previewyoutube="ab6zYdaxLTc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’ve completely updated our Steam page to showcase the game’s current state and immerse you in its atmosphere:[/p][list][*][p]Added gameplay GIFs[/p][/*][*][p] Updated artwork and screenshots[/p][/*][*][p]Crafted a new description that dives deeper into the game’s mood[/p][/*][/list][p]Our vision for Catfall has become clearer, and we’re steadily bringing it to life — now ready to share it with you.[/p][p]Be sure to visit our page and see what’s new![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325350/Catfall/"][/dynamiclink]Wishing everyone a vibrant and inspiring Ukrainian Games Festival 2025! We’ll keep working hard and confidently moving toward a public demo.[/p][p]Thank you for being with us![/p]
